item.title: Shikisai-no-oka Flower Hills — Guide
item.description: Shikisai-no-oka (‘Hills of Seasonal Colour’) is a spectacular flower garden set on the rolling hills of Biei in central Hokkaido, famous for its vast, undulating patchwork of vividly coloured flower fields. Across some 15 hectares, broad stripes of blooms — lavender, poppies, salvia, marigolds, sunflowers, lupins and many more — carpet the hillsides in bands of colour that shift through the summer and autumn, set against a backdrop of the Tokachi mountain range and Biei’s iconic gently rolling farmland.
